title: Course Schedule III
summary: Given an array of courses where each course is defined by its duration and the last day it must be completed by, determine the maximum number of courses that can be taken sequentially starting from the 1st day without any two courses overlapping.
statement: Given an array of courses where each course is defined by its duration and the last day it must be completed by, determine the maximum number of courses that can be taken sequentially starting from the 1st day without any two courses overlapping.
constraints: 1 <= len(courses) <= 10,000; each course is [duration, deadline] with positive integers.
Courses run continuously from day one; return the maximum number that can finish by their deadlines.
hints: When a deadline is missed, discard the longest selected duration.
Process deadlines in order and keep selected durations in a max-heap.
Add each course; if total time exceeds its deadline, remove the longest course.
Replacing the longest course preserves the count while leaving the most time for every future deadline.
editorial: Replacing the longest course preserves the count while leaving the most time for every future deadline.

tests.explanation: Taking durations 100, 1000, and 200 meets all three deadlines.
Each course alone exceeds its own deadline, so none can be completed.
